LESSON: MONEY

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.5: Money

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Money. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-071.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 71]]

From your pupil's book (page 71)

TERM 1 Week 11 Lesson 2 Counting money Activity 1 Activity 2 How much money? How much money?

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-072.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 72]]

From your pupil's book (page 72)

TERM 1 Week 11 Lesson 3 Counting money Activity 1 Activity 2 How much money? How much money?

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-069.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 69]]

From your pupil's book (page 69)

MEASUREMENT MONEY Week 10 Lesson 5 Coins and notes Activity 1 Activity 2 How much? How much?

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Money means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Money.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Money
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
